instruction: The starting input is a broken FLORIS script `/home/user/Desktop/broken.py`. Complete diagnose-fix-rerun purely from the command line: 1. Try running `broken.py`; read error messages and locate all issues; repair `/home/user/Desktop/broken.py` into `/home/user/Desktop/fixed.py`. 2. Re-run and ensure `/home/user/Desktop/fixed_summary.txt` is generated: Format: `turbine_0_kw, turbine_1_kw` 3. Write diagnosis report `/home/user/Desktop/diagnosis.txt` (explain each error cause and fix method item by item; total length >= 100 characters). 4. Do not use any GUI. [Software] Run your scripts with Python in an environment where `floris` is installed (e.g. `from floris import FlorisModel`). For this workflow, FLORIS is provided as the Python `floris` package at `/home/user/.local/lib/python3.12/site-packages/floris`; run the workflow from Python rather than looking for a separate desktop program.
